metadata.description: o-MATIC Supply — tools, not people. Governed MCP connectors for WordPress/Elementor, Microsoft 365, and the o-MATIC Server.

plugins.name: wordpress
plugins.description: o-MATIC Supply — tools, not people. The WordPress and Elementor MCP connectors: site and content operations, Elementor page building, template and theme work, media, and a sandboxed export/import path. Ships MCP servers by design; it is equipment, not staff.

metadata.compatibilityTier: MCP-host-full-operation ONLY — this is a tool pack and requires a host that can spawn an MCP server
metadata.requiresForFullOperation: a host able to launch stdio MCP servers, plus WordPress/Elementor credentials held by the host
metadata.note: Restricted hosts that omit mcpServers plugins will not install this pack. That is expected: a connector without an MCP server is nothing. The PEOPLE who use these tools ship separately in o-MATIC Studio, which is why they are no longer bundled together.

plugins.name: microsoft-365
plugins.description: Team Assistant MCP: governed read/write access to Planner (including Goals), Teams, SharePoint and OneNote over Microsoft Graph. Self-hosted per tenant with delegated device-code sign-in — no central service, no admin-consent-for-others. Premium Planner / Dataverse ("Project") is deliberately out of scope, a separate plugin.

metadata.compatibilityTier: MCP-host-full-operation ONLY — this is a tool pack and requires a host that can spawn an MCP server
metadata.requiresForFullOperation: a host able to launch stdio MCP servers, plus an Entra app registration (tenant ID + client ID) the operator controls
metadata.note: Delegated device-code sign-in only — every call acts as the signed-in user, credentials never leave the host. No OneNote application-permission tier exists in Graph at all, so OneNote is delegated-only by Microsoft's own design, not a limitation of this plugin.

plugins.name: o-matic-server
plugins.description: Connect to an o-MATIC Server using OAuth/SSO; cloud is the default, with on-premises endpoint setup.

metadata.compatibilityTier: Remote MCP hosts with OAuth; host-specific setup may be required
metadata.requiresForFullOperation: an o-MATIC Server reachable over HTTPS Streamable HTTP, OAuth/SSO enabled, and a user-authorized factory grant
metadata.note: Remote connector only. No tokens ship in this package; it does not grant factory access.
